verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only single-item API operations: creating one contact (mailchimp-docs-4), sending one campaign (mailchimp-docs-5), and sending one SMS (mailchimp-docs-6). It shows no batch endpoint, bulk subscribe/update, or multi-item tagging or editing. The account export (mailchimp-docs-16) is a single data-download job, an adjacent feature rather than bulk operations across many items, so it earns no credit.
